title: Solve
tagline: Auto-tests for Solidity smart contracts: upload your contract and get a report
description:
I believe that the best catalyst for Scaling Ethereum is developers. Our common goal is to make their onboarding to the ecosystem easier and safer.  

My project is aimed to build a platform that prevents vulnerabilities and serves as a second layer of security for developers. During this hackathon, I have integrated two libraries with smart contracts analyzers. In the near future, I will add new auto-test algorithms and frameworks for unit-test writing to achieve a higher level of security and transparency.

P. S. No repository yet. Made it with DevOps + NoCode.
how_its_made:
